content:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to clarify the offline installer steps for air-gapped installs. The current text says 'import bundle' but doesn't show the actual tar flags; customers are tripping on permissions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
kevin: @maria thanks — can you paste the minimal command you'd like? also note the KMS env var name mismatch in the SDK snippet.
maria: Suggested command:
```
sudo tar xzf redwood-offline-2024-08.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood --no-same-owner
sudo chown -R redwood:redwood /opt/redwood
```
samir: :thumbsup: add a note about SELinux contexts for RHEL/CentOS — `restorecon -Rv /opt/redwood` or instruct to disable enforcing temporarily.
ops-marco: Also the systemd unit in the doc uses `redwood.service` but our package names it `redwood-agent.service` — that's causing confusion.
kevin: good catch — recommend we change doc to use `redwood-agent.service` and add a note: "service name may differ depending on package".
maria: updated the PR description with both notes and example. I also rewrote the SDK snippet — used `KMS_URL` in one example and `KMS_ENDPOINT` in another; standardized to `KMS_ENDPOINT` and added an env var table.
lina: Quick link fix: the internal HSM PKCS11 appendix link was pointing to /hardware/hsm.md but file lives at /security/hsm-guide.md — I'll patch the link in the PR.
docs-bot: PR #812 — submodule lint: docs-lint passed, linkcheck found 1 broken link (security/hsm-guide.md) — see CI log: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12345
maria: thanks @lina and @docs-bot — I'll wait for CI then request a review from @kevin and @samir.
kevin: review done, left tiny nit on wording for the 'bundle checksum' step.
samir: approved with comments. added SELinux troubleshooting FAQ entry.
maria: pushed fix for checksum wording and added FAQ. CI green.
docs-bot: PR #812 merged by maria (commit 9c7f2e1). Release note: docs v1.24.1 — "offline installer: clarified airgap bundle import and KMS env vars". :tada:
ops-marco: FYI ops playbook updated in internal runbook (link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/offline-install).
